# DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Instruct — q4f16_1 (MLC / WebLLM)

Conversion of [dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Instruct)
(by [Dicta](https://dicta.org.il), Apache-2.0) to the MLC `q4f16_1` format, so it runs in the browser with
[WebLLM](https://github.com/mlc-ai/web-llm) on WebGPU.

DictaLM 3.0 1.7B uses the Qwen3-1.7B architecture, so this conversion reuses WebLLM's prebuilt
`Qwen3-1.7B-q4f16_1_cs1k-webgpu.wasm` model library. Weight layout and `mlc-chat-config.json` mirror
`mlc-ai/Qwen3-1.7B-q4f16_1-MLC`; tokenizer files come from the original model.

```js
const appConfig = {
  model_list: [{
    model: "https://huggingface.co/sivelsguy/DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC",
    model_id: "DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC",
    model_lib: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlc-ai/binary-mlc-llm-libs/main/web-llm-models/v0_2_86/base/Qwen3-1.7B-q4f16_1_cs1k-webgpu.wasm",
    overrides: { context_window_size: 4096 },
  }],
};
```

Used by the open-source Hebrew learning app *Parle*. All credit for the model goes to Dicta.
